title: A Return Authorisation's Balance in a Circle Dues Settlement
content:
## A return authorisation in a Circle dues settlement

The Northbeam Returns and Restocking return authorisation the profile holds is brought into the same
settlement as the dues on a Northbeam Circle Membership, on the side the money runs. The standing of that
return and the amounts outstanding on it decide which side that is.

| Standing of the return | What stands outstanding on it | What the settlement takes |
|---|---|---|
| Inspected or settled | A restocking fee | That outstanding restocking fee is brought in |
| Inspected or settled | No restocking fee, but a refund to the member | That outstanding refund is set against the amount |
| Any other standing | Anything | Nothing is brought in for the return |

## The clause in words

Where that return stands inspected or settled and a restocking fee stands outstanding on it, that
outstanding restocking fee is brought in. Where that return stands inspected or settled, no restocking fee
stands outstanding on it and a refund stands outstanding to the member, that outstanding refund is set
against the amount. Where neither of those holds, nothing is brought in for the return and 0.00 goes into
the settlement on this account.

## Which way the money runs

A restocking fee outstanding on the return is money the member owes, so it is added to the settlement
figure. A refund outstanding to the member is money the member is owed, so it is taken off the settlement
figure. Only one of the two is ever taken, because the refund reading turns on no restocking fee standing
outstanding.

## Hypothetical figures

A return standing inspected with a restocking fee of 45.00 outstanding and a refund of 300.00 outstanding
brings in 45.00 and leaves the refund out of the settlement. The same return with no restocking fee
outstanding sets the refund of 300.00 against the amount instead. A return standing in transit brings in nothing either way.
